milestone: Reader dark-theme full core-page Axe proof
scenario: The application initializes dark theme from the saved preference before navigation, then Workbench and Focus Reader full pages pass settled-state WCAG 2A/AA Axe with color-contrast enabled.

failure_before_repair.result: The existing full-page Axe gate ran only with the default theme; dark coverage was limited to token and settled ArticleList subgates. No dark full-page failure had yet been measured.

repair: Added a dedicated Playwright test that sets only localStorage[ai-reader.theme]=dark before navigation, allowing layout.tsx to own the pre-paint dataset.theme initialization.
Reused settled ArticleList and Focus Reader opacity guards before unrestricted WCAG 2A/AA Axe analysis on both core routes.
No CSS or product visual repair was necessary because the first focused dark full-page probe passed.
